description: Past and recent changes as records, for monitoring a position or auditing a contract's history: the change history as record/v1 records, oldest first: what changed, from what to what, who acted, who may execute or revoke it, when it takes effect, and the transaction and log each rests on. With `address`, one contract's history; without, the feed across every covered contract (filter with `since`, a block number). Paged: pass the previous result's next_cursor. Paid per call over x402; a call without a payment returns the price and where to buy, and charges nothing.

family.description: Feed only: a family id from get_coverage, e.g. metamorpho-v1.1.

observed_status.description: A record's status as first observed; a record never changes, so what is pending now is get_control_state's `pending`.

name: get_change_records
title: Change history and feed (paid)
